taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.intro: Locations, property types and features shared by every agency. Changes reach the website API within a minute.
taxonomy.readOnly: You can look but not change: taxonomy is edited by data operations and super admins.
taxonomy.selectPrompt: Select an item to edit its translations, aliases and area.
taxonomy.dragHint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrows.

aliases.title: Feed aliases
aliases.hint: Spellings that feeds use for this item. Each spelling maps to one item.

polygon.title: Area on the map
polygon.hint: Click to place corners, double-click to finish. Drag corners to adjust.
polygon.unavailable: The map could not be loaded.

errors.LOCATION_ALIAS_TAKEN: This spelling already maps to another item.
errors.TAXONOMY_ALIAS_TAKEN: This spelling already maps to another item.
errors.TAXONOMY_SLUG_TAKEN: Another item already uses this URL slug in this language.
errors.LOCATION_POLYGON_INVALID: The area crosses itself. Redraw it without crossing lines.
errors.LOCATION_PARENT_INVALID: That parent is not one level above.
errors.TAXONOMY_ORDER_INVALID: The list changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the fields: names and slugs are required, slugs use lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not change the taxonomy.

tenant.giveToGetRequired: Must share listings to search the network
tenant.giveToGetReason: Reason (support ticket, why the agency is buyer-only) — kept with the exemption

impersonation.reason: Reason (support ticket, what you will check) — recorded and shown to the agency’s admins
impersonation.warning: Everything you do is recorded under your name and theirs. You cannot change their settings, API keys, billing or two-step verification.
impersonation.banner: You are acting as {user} at {agency} until {time}. Everything you do is recorded.
impersonation.bannerEnded: Your session acting as {user} at {agency} has ended. Nothing more is done in their name.
impersonation.endedNotice: You are no longer acting as another user.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Your staff role cannot act as other users.
errors.IMPERSONATION_TARGET_INVALID: You can only act as an active member of an agency that is not suspended.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

live.title: Live sessions
live.intro: Every staff member currently acting as an agency member. Ending a session stops it on the next request.
live.empty: Nobody is acting as another user right now.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.audited: Every page you open here is itself recorded in the audit log.
audit.badRange: The start date must be before the end date.

request.title: Verification of {agency}
request.changedSince: The agency changed its details after submitting (submitted version {submitted}). You review the current details.

notices.REJECT: Rejected. The agency was emailed your reason.

errors.NOT_FOUND: That request or document no longer exists.
errors.VERIFICATION_STALE: The agency changed its details while you reviewed. Check the current details and decide again.
